landing.hero.title: IPCodex
landing.hero.description: AI reads device documentation so developers write integration code, not search queries.
landing.hero.author: by
landing.why.title: Why This Matters
landing.why.text: Companies integrating physical devices (IP cameras, access control, POS) spend enormous time searching and reading documentation from dozens of manufacturers. Documentation comes in different formats, scattered across websites and PDFs, with no versioning and inaccessible to AI tools. Structured Markdown documentation is what AI assistants (Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot) need to help with integration.
landing.problems.title: Problems Today
landing.problems.formatChaos.title: Format Chaos
landing.problems.formatChaos.text: PDF, Swagger, web pages, wikis — every vendor has its own format and portal.
landing.problems.noVersioning.title: No Versioning
landing.problems.noVersioning.text: Documentation changes with every firmware; unclear which API version is current.
landing.problems.aiCantHelp.title: AI Can't Help
landing.problems.aiCantHelp.text: LLMs don't know device APIs; fragments are copy-pasted into chat manually.
landing.problems.codingBlind.title: Coding Blind
landing.problems.codingBlind.text: AI in IDE has no access to documentation; code is written with wrong endpoints and parameters.
landing.goals.title: What We'll Achieve
landing.goals.storage.title: Unified Documentation Storage
landing.goals.storage.text: All documentation in one place, in Markdown, versioned by firmware. Conversion from PDF (with OCR), Swagger/OpenAPI, and web pages.
landing.goals.audit.title: Full Audit & Control
landing.goals.audit.text: Every import is a job with history: who, when, result, duration. Diff between versions shows API changes.
landing.goals.aiCode.title: AI Writes Integration Code
landing.goals.aiCode.text: In AI IDE, ask "how to connect Hikvision via ISAPI" and get working code with real endpoints and parameters.
landing.goals.aiChat.title: AI Chat with Documentation
landing.goals.aiChat.text: Built-in chat: question → answer with citations from documents. Choose context: all devices, vendor, or firmware.
landing.goals.multilingual.title: Multilingual + Translation
landing.goals.multilingual.text: Any documentation language; optional translation to English before conversion (LLM, DeepL, Google Translate).
landing.goals.speedup.title: 3–5× Development Speedup
landing.goals.speedup.text: Instead of hours reading PDFs — semantic search across the knowledge base and integration code generation.
landing.howItWorks.title: How It Works
landing.howItWorks.subtitle: Click each step to see usage scenario details.
landing.howItWorks.step1.title: Upload
landing.howItWorks.step1.text: Upload PDF, Swagger, or web page. Documentation language doesn't matter — optional translation to English.
landing.howItWorks.step2.title: Conversion
landing.howItWorks.step2.text: OCR extracts text, tables, and structure. Converts to Markdown with headings, code blocks, and tables.
landing.howItWorks.step3.title: Storage
landing.howItWorks.step3.text: Result is saved with versioning by device and firmware. Diff shows API changes between versions.
landing.howItWorks.step4.title: AI Indexing
landing.howItWorks.step4.text: Markdown is split into fragments by headings. Each fragment is vectorized and saved for semantic search.
landing.howItWorks.step5.title: AI Writes Code
landing.howItWorks.step5.text: Ask in AI IDE or built-in chat — get working code with verified endpoints and authentication.
landing.footer.author: Aleh Vaitsekhovich
